items.title: Classical provability of higher-order infinitary geometric implications implies intuitionistic provability
items.author: Thomas Traversie; Olivier Hermant; Marc Aiguier
items.source_version: Official FSCD2026.33 CC BY4.0 PDF Theorem45 and entire Section5 proof development, same work as HAL05694098v1; exact cited FSCD2025.34 Lemma16 and connected finite author proof development actually collected as support; retrieved2026-10-14
items.difficulty_reason: The authors build a parameterized higher-order Friedman/Kuroda translation compatible with substitution and conversion for countably indexed proposition families, prove the infinitary disjunction introduction/elimination and PEM embedding cases, and use geometric-axiom translation plus the choice R=B to eliminate classical reasoning. The essential finite derivation cases explicitly transferred from the earlier author Lemma16 are actually retained with their complete surrounding development. This non-routine infinitary proof translation/constructivization construction supports H2 as one main Barr theorem, not separate counts for the translation or finite predecessor.
